claim_checks.claim: Acquisition returns: ROATCE high-teens; ROATCE <15% thesis breaker
claim_checks.finding: ROATCE: FY19 22.0%, FY21 17.4%, FY22 17.3%, FY23 18.1%, FY24 19.1%, FY25 20.9%, H1-26 22.7%. FY24: acquisitions 'together delivering 20% ROATCE in year one'. Recent deals at average ~8x (H1-26: 15 deals LTM c.GBP310m at avg 8x; 7 deals c.GBP180m at avg 9x incl. CDM). ROATCE definition uses pro forma annualised adj. operating profit / adjusted trading capital employed (incl. goodwill/acquired intangibles gross of amortisation).
